title: Generated record of processing
description: Record of processing generated from the deployed schema catalog plus a manually maintained register of non-schema stores, with a diff against the prior version.
producer: not yet assigned (candidate: Unbound build pipeline using Strata schema metadata)
retention: Life of service plus 7 years (proposed; counsel to confirm)

title: Privacy program review record
description: Dated review of the privacy program with findings, decisions and owner sign-off, stored as a Praxis decision record.
producer: Praxis (governance record format exists; no review has occurred)

title: Internal access by declared purpose
description: Per-tenant log of every Echelon-internal access to tenant data with declared purpose, actor type (human or AI agent), authority reference and result, exportable to the customer.
producer: not yet assigned (candidate: Unbound audit event stream)

title: Breach notification timeline record
description: Per incident: awareness time, customer notification time, recipients, content hash and acknowledgment, demonstrating notification within the committed window.

title: Annual Safeguards-element report
description: Written annual report to the governing body covering the information security program elements, risk assessment results, service provider oversight and material events.

title: Subprocessor register history
description: Versioned register with each change, notice date, customer objections and effective date, plus egress configuration hash showing data flows only to listed subprocessors.

title: Rights request case record
description: Case record per request: requester, verification method, sponsor decision, records located, erasure events (key destruction IDs), records retained with exception basis, completion time.
producer: not yet assigned (candidate: Unbound privacy case workflow)
retention: Per retention schedule; counsel to confirm

title: Data location attestation
description: Daily inventory of data-bearing resources with region, generated from the provider API and compared to the approved-region policy, plus access-origin summary.

title: PIA register and gate results
description: Register of PIAs linked to change records, and CI gate results showing no unlinked changes to tagged elements.

title: Portal tracking inventory
description: Automated crawl of portal pages recording cookies, storage keys, script and frame origins, and CSP headers, compared with the approved inventory.

title: Minor record access report
description: Report of person records flagged as minors, fields populated and any access by roles other than sponsor and advising donor.

title: Model call and agent access log
description: Per call: tenant, purpose, provider, model, data classes present, retention mode; per agent access grant: approver, scope, expiry, actions taken.
producer: not yet assigned (candidate: model gateway and access broker)

title: Aggregate release log
description: Record of each aggregate release with parameters, cohort sizes, suppression applied and approver.
